product_description_excerpt: Fluently is an app that helps non-native professionals improve their English with instant feedback after each Zoom call. Imagine having a personal coach, always listening and providing tips. There are 84 million non-native employees who work in English-speaking environments, and companies spend $10 billion annually solely on their English corporate training to improve communication efficiency across the company and help them grow and feel more
